{"answerable": true, "sql": "WITH latest AS (
  SELECT model_version, window_close
  FROM warehouse.risk_score
  ORDER BY window_close DESC, scored_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT l.model_version AS model_version,
       l.window_close AS window_close,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.alerted) AS alerted_learners,
       count(*) AS scored_learners
FROM warehouse.risk_score r
JOIN latest l
  ON r.model_version = l.model_version
 AND r.window_close = l.window_close
GROUP BY l.model_version, l.window_close;", "reason": ""}
